```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fivethirtyeight)
library(tidytext)
library(ggtext)
library(countrycode)
```

```{r}
drinks %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("servings"), 
               names_to = "alcohol", 
               values_to = "ile", 
               names_pattern = "(.+)_") %>% 
  relocate(total_litres_of_pure_alcohol, .after = everything()) %>% 
  mutate(czy_polska = country == "Poland",
         continent = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent"),
         country = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "cldr.name.pl"),
         etykieta = if_else(czy_polska, paste0("<span style='color:#8B0000;'>**", country, "**</span>"), country),
         etykieta = reorder_within(etykieta, by = ile, within = alcohol),
         alcohol = fct_recode(alcohol, "wino" = "wine", "piwo" = "beer", "spirytus" = "spirit"),
         alcohol = fct_relevel(alcohol, "wino", "piwo", "spirytus")) %>% 
  group_by(alcohol) %>% 
  slice_max(ile, n = 20) %>% 
  filter(continent == "Europe") %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(ile, etykieta)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = czy_polska), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ile), hjust = 1.15, size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ alcohol, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "darkred", "FALSE" = "darkgray")) +
  labs(title = "Spożycie alkoholu", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
drinks %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("servings"), 
               names_to = "alcohol", 
               values_to = "ile", 
               names_pattern = "(.+)_") %>% 
  relocate(total_litres_of_pure_alcohol, .after = everything()) %>% 
  mutate(czy_polska = country == "Poland",
         continent = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent"),
         country = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "cldr.name.pl"),
         etykieta = if_else(czy_polska, paste0("<span style='color:#8B0000;'>**", country, "**</span>"), country),
         etykieta = reorder_within(etykieta, by = ile, within = alcohol),
         alcohol = fct_recode(alcohol, "wino" = "wine", "piwo" = "beer", "spirytus" = "spirit"),
         alcohol = fct_relevel(alcohol, "wino", "piwo", "spirytus")) %>% 
  count(continent)
```
